phases.title: Repository foundation and evidence baseline
phases.summary: Foundation documentation, owner scope, safety boundaries, and phase status automation reviewed and recorded.

phases.title: Requirements and CPU/GPU/NPU compatibility research
phases.summary: Official package/runtime research and device compatibility limits documented from current local indexes and primary references.

phases.title: Safe native desktop lifecycle
phases.summary: Native lifecycle and preview-first installer passed scoped gates. Current read-only native recheck at 08:16 UTC reconfirmed all 77 recovered XFCE package versions installed at their exact recorded versions; the desktop remains running on :1. The original full pre-consent dependency simulation remains unrecoverable and explicitly documented.

revision_notes.reason: Historical gate remains closed; its former next action depended on Debian workflows, which owner-directed Native-only scope has retired.

phases.title: Doctor, management, and recovery
phases.summary: P3 exit gates reviewed and passed; RB08 Native cold-boot and authenticated 8023 readiness are documented, checkpoint remains NOT_READY with auto-resume disabled, and the four-client interactive terminal remains staged for P4 by owner decision.

revision_notes.reason: Historical gate remains closed; its former next action described the retired PRoot provider roadmap.

phases.title: Owner-directed retirement of former PRoot provider
phases.summary: P4 closed by owner-directed Native-only retirement: six guests and both manager packages removed, guest lifecycle/client code retired, Native controls preserved, and 654 repository tests pass.

revision_notes.reason: Corrected the phase title to describe the completed Native-only retirement decision.

phases.title: Native Termux profile compatibility
phases.summary: Recorded the sole directly observed Android 16/Termux 0.119.0-beta.3 Native profile, exact display/audio/package versions, and graphics probe failure; all other combinations remain unqualified.

revision_notes.reason: Native profile compatibility gate is complete; dated matrix and follow-up evidence are recorded.

phases.title: CPU/GPU/NPU capability, optimization, and fallback
phases.summary: At P6 close, CPU was the only implemented inference path and GPU/NPU workload execution was unverified. This is a dated assessment, superseded by P12 evidence for bounded Vulkan GPU inference and experimental SM8735 HTP inference; broader qualification remains open.

revision_notes.reason: P6 is closed; its previous next_action was the work completed by the P6 completion review and must not remain as an active instruction.
Owner clarified that capability assessment completion did not complete Native acceleration implementation.
Clarify that its closed assessment is a dated capability snapshot; P12 later implemented bounded GPU and experimental HTP inference.

phases.title: Native apps and curated software catalog
phases.summary: Three-ID Native Termux lifecycle is implemented across CLI, TUI, Web, and GTK through shared authorization; 706 tests passed, live previews were read-only, and no app package was applied.

revision_notes.reason: The P7 completion run reached 706 passing tests; its implementation action is stale after the gate closed.

phases.title: Native workload and accelerator routing
phases.summary: Native workload checks, HOME-scoped name handoff, interactive guidance, all four Cron schedule types, and Cron job/execution inspection across CLI/TUI/Web/GTK are covered; the latest full suite passes 727 tests. Historical reboot checkpoints and accelerator proof limits remain explicit.

revision_notes.reason: P8 completed with reviewed acceptance evidence; remove the obsolete active work instruction.
A verified interactive-guide PTY contract was added after P8; update its test count without changing the accepted gate.
The complete suite now includes the verified interactive-guide PTY and non-TTY contracts.
Refresh completed-suite evidence after Cron Web/GTK parity and form coverage changes; no gate status change.
Update phase evidence to the latest full suite after all Cron schedule-type clients moved to typed shared-service creation.
Refresh the closed P8 descriptive summary after verified Cron inspection parity follow-up; preserve the original phase gate and date.

phases.title: Optional isolated workload profile
phases.summary: Skipped under the Native-only product direction that was active on 2026-10-24; owner later superseded that decision and reauthorized Debian PRoot support. Historical skip is retained; restoration is tracked in P11.
phases.next_action: Keep this optional phase deferred unless a specific Native workload gap is documented and approved.

revision_notes.reason: Owner superseded the Native-only decision and reauthorized Debian PRoot restoration.

phases.title: Hardening, release, and support
phases.summary: At P10 close, internal hardening covered Native-only backup/recovery inspection across TUI/Web/GTK and the full suite passed 730 tests. The owner later restored Debian PRoot support in P11. Public release remains blocked by unresolved license/provenance, owner-managed SSH exposure, and clean-device qualification.

revision_notes.reason: P10 internal review completed; public release blockers are documented separately and no phase action remains.
The SSH diagnostic identified the exact owner-managed 8022 configuration; distinguish it from Ternuxx-managed 8023.
Record the verified post-closure read-only recovery-client follow-up in P10 descriptive metadata without reopening the original internal-hardening gate.
Label the completed hardening scope and test count as historical because PRoot support was later restored.

phases.title: Restore Debian PRoot support on Native Termux
phases.summary: Restored and verified Debian PRoot lifecycle, terminal, GUI routing, and shared CLI/TUI/Web/GTK acceptance on Native Termux; full suite passes 986 tests.

revision_notes.reason: P11 acceptance and its final live checks are complete; remove its stale next action that still requested closing P11.

phases.title: Qualify Native CPU, GPU and NPU acceleration
phases.summary: The GPL-3.0-or-later source license is recorded; exact candidate ELF and SDK evidence are documented. Reproducible HTP artifact redistribution and all three backend performance/stability qualification remain open.
phases.next_action: Resolve exact runtime/toolchain redistribution rights and, after substantial cooling, run the benchmark protocol with comparable launch conditions and repeated CPU/Vulkan/HTP trials.
